name: Constantine
source:
The ruler of sprites that is living in the world of humans. She is super powerful and has the ability to make magic tools. Her personality is nonsensical. She is abnormally forgetful and the type that is unable to read the situation.

[Based on the [url=http://www.littlewitch.jp/home/special/LWRQ/pg115.html]official site[/url]]
